correctStatements.text: At 11:00 petra reported search errors for about a third of queries.
At 11:06 ali saw one shard red with its replica unassigned.
Ops swapped a failing disk on that node and restored the data directory from an older snapshot.
At 11:20 ali found the shard files did not match the cluster state.
At 11:32 quin pointed the app to the read only copy in the other region.
At 11:40 quin saw errors drop to zero though results might be a day old.
At 11:48 ali started reindexing the damaged shard from the database.
At 13:10 ali saw the reindex finish and the cluster turn green.
At 13:20 quin switched the app back to the main cluster.
Search had about 2 hours of partial failures followed by stale results.
Ali will write down the disk swap procedure so the restore step uses the latest snapshot.
Quin will set up the regional read only copy as a documented fallback.
